title: finding(changeset): the pending 8499 entry publishes a RENDERER REGISTRY size of 656 twice, once as a re-measurement — the same instrument reads 644 and 649, and it was already false before objectui#9641 branched
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat, session `session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L`, R1. ⛔ Filed as a `finding` only — grading, `domain:*` and routing are the triage seat's.

## The defect

`.changeset/8499-node-slot-registered-arms.md` is **pending** — unconsumed, so it publishes **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release. It states the size of this repository's renderer registry as **656 keys**, twice:

| line | text |
|---|---|
| `:19` | 「… judges against the RENDERER REGISTRY (**656** keys) and not against `AnyComponentSchema` (107 arm literals).」 |
| `:91` | 「… literals when it was written; **re-measured here it is 656** against 154, so the …」 |

⚠️ The second one is the load-bearing one: it does not merely quote a number, it claims the number was **re-measured**.

## Measured — and it is false at BOTH refs, ⛔ so it was already false before objectui#9641 branched

Counting the quoted entries in the generated list the same instrument produces, `packages/cli/src/utils/known-schema-types.ts`:

| ref | entries |
|---|---|
| `72f55c9ec` — objectui#9641's merge-base | **644** |
| `b9603eba9` — that card's landing head | **649** |
| **absent-token control**, same query | **0** |
| **lit controls**, the five keys objectui#9641 adds | `ui:page` / `ui:app` / `ui:utility` / `ui:home` / `ui:record` read **1 each** at the head and **0** at the merge-base |

⇒ 656 matches neither. The delta objectui#9641 introduces is **+5**, which cannot reconcile 644 or 649 to 656 in either direction. **The number was stale before that branch existed**, which is why it is filed here rather than corrected there: ⛔ a card corrects only what its own diff falsifies, and this diff falsifies nothing — it inherits a sentence that was already wrong.

⚠️ **The instrument used here is a proxy and is declared as such.** This seat counted quoted entries in the generated file; the entry's own wording says 「RENDERER REGISTRY」. Whether the entry meant the generated list, `deriveRegistryKeys`'s return, or a live `ComponentRegistry` enumeration is ⛔ **not established**, and the three need not be equal. **Whoever takes this card must fix the reading before fixing the number** — replacing one unverified figure with another is this defect committed a second time.

## Why it is worth a card

A `.changeset` body publishes **verbatim**. Once released, 「re-measured here it is 656」 is a permanent, dated, false measurement in published history, and the natural reaction of a future reader who checks it is to distrust the instrument rather than the sentence. This board has landed two cards on exactly this shape today — objectui#9625 (a pending entry claiming a pin that had been deleted) and objectui#9692's item 5 (a pending entry overclaiming what its pin measured) — both prose-only corrections to pending entries, both beating the window only because somebody read them in time.

⛔ The fallback does not hold: no open PR touches this entry, and a pending changeset is precisely the file nobody passes on the way to something else. There is no note-carrier, which is why this is a card.

⚠️ The window is open **now**: release PR objectui#5400 is open, and the entry is consumed the moment it merges.

## The repair, as far as this card goes

Prose only, frontmatter byte-identical, level and package list untouched — the shape `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` reports as its legitimate **case 2**. ⛔ And ⛔ not a bare number swap: state which instrument the figure comes from, or drop the figure. A count that cannot be re-derived from its own sentence is how this entry got here.

## Dedup terms

`8499-node-slot-registered-arms` · `renderer registry 656` · `known-schema-types count` · `pending changeset stale number` · `re-measured here`

## Provenance

Found by the objectui#9641 closing-round implementer while answering the `changeset-claim-re-read` gate on PR objectui#9686, and correctly ⛔ **not** edited there — another card's pending entry, already false, is outside a round capped to 「prose made true + known gaps pinned」. Routed to this seat, which re-derived the 644 / 649 / control readings above before filing.
